newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Waterford Wedgwood buys Rosenthal stake.
newsitem.headline: Waterford Wedgwood buys Rosenthal stake.

text.p: Irish crystal and china firm Waterford Wedgwood Plc said on Thursday it was buying an initial 9.1 percent stake in German porcelain firm Rosenthal, through the issue by Rosenthal of 60,000 new ordinary shares.
Waterford Wedgwood said in a statement that the new Rosenthal shares would be issued at or close to the prevailing market price.

Waterford Wedgwood said it planned to establish a strategic alliance with Rosenthal and had options to acquire an aggregate 15 percent of the German firm, exercisable at varying dates and prices up to the end of the year 2000.
It said the alliance would improve joint penetration of the German and British markets and foster improved overseas sales for Rosenthal.
"This is an outstanding opportunity to forge a true strategic alliance with another of the world's great tabletop companies," Waterford Wedgwood chairman Tony O'Reilly said in a statement.

"I am sure that, together, we can restore the fortunes of Rosenthal to the benefit of our employees and shareholders alike, as Waterford Wedgwood continues to grow in the luxury brand business," he said.
